# Hughes2009: Circadian Liver Transcriptome

The `Hughes2009` package provides processed liver transcriptome data
from the Hughes et al. (2009) study on circadian rhythms. It contains
normalized expression data and gene-level summaries, designed for
testing circadian analysis workflows and co-expression network
construction.

# Installation

You can install the development version of `Hughes2009` from GitHub:

``` r
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("altintasali/Hughes2009")
```

# Quick Start

This package provides an `ExpressionSet` object containing mouse liver
microarray data across a 48-hour period.

``` r
library(Hughes2009)
library(Biobase)
```

``` r
# Load the dataset
data(eset)

# Peek at the data
show(eset)
```

``` R
## ExpressionSet (storageMode: lockedEnvironment)
## assayData: 45101 features, 48 samples 
##   element names: exprs 
## protocolData
##   sampleNames: GSM301348.CEL.gz GSM301349.CEL.gz ... GSM301395.CEL.gz
##     (48 total)
##   varLabels: ScanDate
##   varMetadata: labelDescription
## phenoData
##   sampleNames: GSM301348 GSM301349 ... GSM301395 (48 total)
##   varLabels: title geo_accession ... relation.1 (33 total)
##   varMetadata: labelDescription
## featureData
##   featureNames: 1415670_at 1415671_at ... AFFX-r2-P1-cre-5_at (45101
##     total)
##   fvarLabels: PROBEID SYMBOL GENENAME MAS5_CALL
##   fvarMetadata: labelDescription
## experimentData: use 'experimentData(object)'
## Annotation: mouse4302
```

``` r
# Extract expression matrix
expression_matrix <- exprs(eset)

# Print first 6 rows and columns
print(expression_matrix[1:6, 1:6])
```


``` r
# Extract metadata
meta <- pData(eset)

# Print first 6 rows and columns
print(meta[1:6, 1:6])
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`eset`](https://altintasali.github.io/Hughes2009/reference/CircadianData.md)
  [`eset_collapsed`](https://altintasali.github.io/Hughes2009/reference/CircadianData.md)
  : Circadian Liver Microarray Data (GSE11923)
- [`collapse_eset()`](https://altintasali.github.io/Hughes2009/reference/collapse_eset.md)
  : Collapse probes to gene symbols
- [`filter_mas5()`](https://altintasali.github.io/Hughes2009/reference/filter_mas5.md)
  : Filter ExpressionSet by MAS5 presence
- [`plot_boxplots()`](https://altintasali.github.io/Hughes2009/reference/plot_boxplots.md)
  : Plot Overlaid Boxplots for all samples
- [`plot_densities()`](https://altintasali.github.io/Hughes2009/reference/plot_densities.md)
  : Plot Overlaid Density for all samples
